description:
Software Developer 
 Are you a skilled software developer who enjoys building and enhancing applications that support critical business needs? 
 Do you enjoy working with technical and business teams to design solutions, solve complex problems, and deliver reliable applications? 
 About the Role 
 As a Software Developer, you will create and modify computer programs by converting system requirements and designs into application code. You will work with technical team members, business analysts, and subject matter experts to develop solutions that meet defined business and technical requirements. 
 In this role, you will participate in requirements and design discussions, develop and test application code, troubleshoot system issues, and support enhancements and upgrades while ensuring development standards are consistently followed. 
 Responsibilities 
 As a Software Developer, you will be responsible for: 
 Writing application code that meets defined requirements and adheres to documented designs. 
 Performing unit and unit integration testing on developed code. 
 Participating in JAD sessions to understand requirements and provide technical options when designing solutions. 
 Working with technical team members, business analysts, and subject matter experts to analyze and resolve system problems. 
 Documenting system designs and changes to system designs. 
 Providing impact analysis for proposed system upgrades and enhancements. 
 Assisting system and acceptance testers with troubleshooting anomalies, understanding impacts, and identifying solutions to bugs or gaps in functionality. 
 Reporting issues and status to management, as directed. 
 Understanding and adhering to established development standards and ensuring code is compliant with those standards. 
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or foreign equivalent to a bachelor's degree, is desired. A reasonable combination of education, training, and experience may be considered. 
 Minimum of three years of relevant software development experience. 
 Experience with ASP.NET, Dapper, AutoMapper, C#, and Visual Studio 2019. 
 Experience with JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, AJAX, .NET Framework 4.8, and .NET Core. 
 Experience with SQL Server 2019, including the design and development of stored procedures, triggers, and user-defined functions. 
 Experience with HTML5, XML, XSLT, and CSS. 
 Experience developing and working with RESTful APIs. 
 Experience with RabbitMQ. 
 Experience with OAuth and JWT. 
 Experience with Azure DevOps and Git. 
 Knowledge of Object-Oriented Methodologies and Object-Oriented Design. 
 Knowledge of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA). 
   
 Flexible Working 
 At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. 
 In this role, you can expect the following working conditions: 
 Onsite work: Work in our local office, receiving personal coaching and leadership so that you can provide the best support to our clients and help you grow in your career. 
 Working For You 
 Perks and rewards designed for you: 
 Health and Welfare Benefits: Our health and welfare benefits can be tailored to fit your needs and start on the first day of employment. 
 Retirement Savings: We support you as you invest in your future. 
 Employee Discounts: We offer you access to a vast selection of global, national, and local discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more. 
 Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint. 
 Training: Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career. 
 Great Work Environment: We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts. 
 Join Us 
 At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can: 
 Bring your authentic self to work. 
 Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally 
 Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support. 
   
 With a large workforce across 24 countries, we’re proud to foster a truly global culture—one that supports well-being, values every contribution, and empowers our people to grow both personally and professionally.  
   
 Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is ($63,140 - $82,000) 
   
  
  
  



 Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
